Drone incident near Zelenskyy's plane, UK sabotage plot reported

A drone incident occurred near a plane carrying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as he was en route to Norway for King Harald V's funeral. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that the drone attack happened near the Moldova-Ukraine border, resulting in two deaths, and warned that Polish border posts could also be attacked. Ukrainian officials confirmed the drone almost struck Zelenskyy's plane before takeoff. Separately, a British man is accused in a UK court of preparing to sabotage a drone factory for Russia. Russian President Vladimir Putin has reportedly supplied Russian postmen with anti-drone weapons.
